WITH completed_transplants AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.match_rec_registry,
        re.cost_qaly,
        c.med_urgency,
        CAST(SUBSTRING(re.cost_qaly FROM '([0-9]+)') AS numeric) AS cer_value,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5
            WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
            WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 2', '2') THEN 3
            WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 3', '3') THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END AS urgency_rank
    FROM transplant_matching tm
    JOIN risk_evaluation re ON tm.match_rec_registry = re.risk_eval_registry
    JOIN clinical c ON tm.recip_ref_reg = c.clin_recip_registry
    WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed'
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        med_urgency,
        ROUND(CAST(AVG(cer_value) AS numeric), 2) AS avg_cer,
        COUNT(*) AS num_transplants,
        MAX(urgency_rank) AS urgency_rank
    FROM completed_transplants
    GROUP BY med_urgency
)
SELECT 
    med_urgency,
    avg_cer,
    num_transplants
FROM grouped
ORDER BY urgency_rank DESC;
